746730101.text: C'mon, little one, I really don't know how to dive. Look! I don't even have a divesuit.

746730102.text: *sigh*... No matter how much you jump and dance, I still can't follow you down there...

746730105.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Fancy meeting you here again, of all places. Quite the coincidence.

746730106.text: You haven't changed a bit! Still popular with the Seelie. And... it looks like you're getting better and better at communicating with them!

746730107.text: Translate what the Seelie is saying for me, please.

746730108.text: *sigh* Please don't make fun of me. I don't have a clue what it's trying to say.

746730109.text: I just came here to do some business and decided to take a stroll by the water. Suddenly a Seelie started following me out of nowhere... again.

746730110.text: I'm used to this sort of thing by now, so I followed it. Up hill and down dale, I even had to row a boat for a bit.

746730111.text: Normally, they start bouncing around to tell me "something's buried here!"

746730112.text: But... It keeps diving into the water, deeper and deeper...

746730113.text: But I haven't got a clue how to dive! I've heard other people saying that the waters here not only have powerful currents, but also all kinds of other dangers... All I can do is sit here on my little boat, waiting for it to return.

746730114.text: But that little guy is still leading me to place after place... I really want it to know that I really don't know how to dive...
